{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter out sentinel values (-1) for customer_age
valid_ages = data[data['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute and print the number of valid age entries
num_valid_ages = len(valid_ages)
print(f"Number of valid age entries: {num_valid_ages}")

# Compute and print the mean age
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()
print(f"Mean age of customers with valid age data: {mean_age:.4f} years")"}
